description_en: Queries whether Anti-DDoS Origin is authorized to access Simple Log Service
description_zh: 查询DDoS原生防护是否被授权访问阿里云日志服务
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp check-access-log-auth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckAccessLogAuth

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

For more information about the valid values of this parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188196.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所属地域ID。

关于该参数的取值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188196.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. If this parameter is empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

AccessLogAuth.description_en:
Indicates whether Anti-DDoS Origin is authorized to access Simple Log Service. Valid values:
true: Authorized.
false: Not authorized
AccessLogAuth.description_zh:
DDoS原生防护是否被授权访问阿里云日志服务。取值：
true：表示已经获得授权。
false：表示没有获得授权
